text: KBase Data Lakehouse collections are migrating from Delta to Iceberg, changing table addresses from underscore-joined identifiers to catalog.namespace.table identifiers.
quote: **Problem**: BERDL collections are migrating from Delta to Iceberg, and the table-naming convention changed with it. heading: [all] Namespace Convention Changed from Underscores to Dots (Delta → Iceberg)
